question: Within 10 kilometers, where can I find a restaurant ahead of Cyrus Dallin Art Museum, Arlington, MA toward Tewksbury Hospital, Tewksbury, MA?
sql: WITH museum AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Cyrus Dallin Art Museum%' LIMIT 1 ), hospital AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Tewksbury Hospital%' LIMIT 1 ), target_direction AS ( SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(m.geometry, h.geometry)) AS bearing_to_hospital, m.geometry AS museum_geometry FROM museum m, hospital h ) SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_state, p.addr_city FROM pois p, target_direction td WHERE p.amenity = 'restaurant' AND ST_DWithin(p.geometry::geography, td.museum_geometry::geography, 10000) -- Within 10 km of the museum AND ( -- Calculate the bearing from the museum to the restaurant -- And check if it's within a 45-degree cone (22.5 degrees on either side) of the target bearing LEAST( ABS(degrees(ST_Azimuth(td.museum_geometry, p.geometry)) - td.bearing_to_hospital), 360 - ABS(degrees(ST_Azimuth(td.museum_geometry, p.geometry)) - td.bearing_to_hospital) ) <= 22.5 );
